title: Design System: Food Label Health Agent

display.purpose: Hero headlines and major workflow headings; Chinese wrapping follows physical width rather than character units.

body.purpose: Plain-language instructions, findings, and safety limitations.

evidence.purpose: OCR confidence, field counts, source metadata, and measurement labels only.

shadows.name: card-offset
shadows.purpose: Structural depth for proof and review work surfaces.

shadows.name: action-offset
shadows.purpose: Directional depth for the primary upload action.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus reinforcement around interactive controls.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared settling curve for proof and review transitions.

motion.name: review-arrive
motion.purpose: Brings the review rail into the workspace after OCR.

motion.name: proof-settle
motion.purpose: Lets uploaded evidence replace the example package.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Control, annotation, disclosure, and status changes.

components.name: Editorial Primary Button
components.description: The single primary workflow action in each state.

components.name: Evidence Correction Field
components.description: Editable OCR evidence with explicit confidence and confirmation state.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--ink,#202727);font:700 11px/1.4 SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace}.ds-field>span{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.ds-field b{color:var(--caution,#8A4B08)}.ds-field textarea{min-height:92px;border:1px solid rgba(32,39,39,.26);border-radius:14px;padding:13px 14px;color:var(--ink,#202727);background:var(--paper,#FFFFFF);font:450 16px/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC',sans-serif;resize:vertical}.ds-field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--teal,#138A7C);outline:4px solid rgba(19,138,124,.22)}.ds-field small{color:var(--muted-small,#64716F);font:450 12px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC',sans-serif}

components.name: Tactile Upload Card
components.description: Functional Bento surface that pairs capture guidance with the upload action.
components.css: .ds-upload{display:grid;min-height:300px;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;align-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(32,39,39,.08);border-radius:28px;background:var(--paper,#FFFFFF);color:var(--ink,#202727);box-shadow:12px 14px 0 rgba(32,39,39,.09),0 28px 60px rgba(32,39,39,.08);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 180ms}.ds-upload:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-package{align-self:stretch;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#A9DFE5,#F4F6F5)}.ds-upload>span:last-child{display:grid;gap:10px;padding:28px}.ds-upload b{display:grid;width:48px;height:48px;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal,#138A7C);color:#FFF}.ds-upload strong{font:800 28px/1 'Avenir Next','SF Pro Display','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-upload small{color:var(--muted-small,#64716F)}.ds-upload:focus-within{outline:4px solid rgba(19,138,124,.22);outline-offset:-5px}

components.name: Constraint Choice
components.description: A 44-pixel-plus hard-constraint control with text and selected state.
components.css: .ds-choice{position:relative;display:inline-flex;cursor:pointer}.ds-choice input{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0}.ds-choice span{display:grid;min-width:72px;min-height:48px;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(32,39,39,.26);border-radius:999px;background:var(--paper,#FFFFFF);color:var(--ink,#202727);padding:10px 17px;font:720 16px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC',sans-serif;transition:background 180ms,border-color 180ms,color 180ms,transform 180ms}.ds-choice:hover span{border-color:var(--teal,#138A7C);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-choice input:checked+span{border-color:var(--teal,#138A7C);background:var(--lime,#B7E95B);color:var(--deep,#101817)}.ds-choice input:focus-visible+span{outline:3px solid var(--paper,#FFFFFF);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--teal,#138A7C)}

components.name: Workflow State Pill
components.description: Compact workflow state; never used as a health conclusion by itself.

components.css: .ds-evidence{max-width:430px;border-block:1px solid rgba(32,39,39,.14);color:var(--ink,#202727);font:450 16px/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-evidence summary{display:grid;min-height:52px;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:760}.ds-evidence summary small{color:var(--muted-small,#64716F);font:700 11px/1.4 SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace}.ds-evidence summary:focus-visible{border-radius:12px;outline:3px solid rgba(19,138,124,.22);outline-offset:3px}.ds-evidence>div{border-top:1px solid rgba(32,39,39,.14);padding:16px 0 20px}.ds-evidence strong,.ds-evidence a{color:var(--teal,#138A7C)}.ds-evidence a{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;align-items:center;font-weight:750;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-evidence a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(19,138,124,.22);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: The Personal Health Log turns a photographed package into a calm, tangible evidence workspace. The visual language uses a pale cool canvas, white rounded cards, acid-lime primary actions, soft cyan, coral and lilac data accents, and compact mobile-health dashboard patterns. It never lets decoration imply a health result. The first viewport contains exactly one promise and one task. After OCR succeeds, the editorial introduction exits and the uploaded label becomes the visual focus beside its correction fields.
keyCharacteristics: Function inside the Bento. Every visible card performs upload, review, status, or recovery work.
Progressive disclosure. OCR correction appears only after fields exist; downstream Agent routing stays out of the consumer UI.
Evidence before interpretation. Uploaded imagery and confirmed text lead. Decoration cannot imply a health result.
Plain-language safety. Risk states combine words and symbols, never color alone; no absolute health score or medical clearance.

rules.body: Every visible card performs upload, review, status, or recovery work.

rules.name: Progressive Disclosure
rules.body: OCR correction appears only after fields exist; downstream Agent routing stays out of the consumer UI.

rules.name: Evidence Before Interpretation
rules.body: Uploaded imagery and confirmed text lead. Decoration cannot imply a health result.

rules.name: Plain-language Safety
rules.body: Risk states combine words and symbols, never color alone; no absolute health score or medical clearance.

dos: Do keep every visible card tied to upload, review, status, evidence, or recovery.
Do reveal OCR correction only after fields exist.
Do let uploaded imagery and confirmed text lead interpretation.
Do pair every risk color with explicit state language and a symbol.
donts: Don't expose LangGraph nodes, RAG routes, MCP calls, or roadmap stages to consumers.
Don't create equal cards for explanatory filler.
Don't use the generated package as a real product, recommendation, or OCR result.
Don't label a food simply safe, healthy, or unhealthy.
Don't rely on hover for essential information.
Don't reconstruct deleted images or invent missing evidence.
